<script>
(function(){
  var reduce = matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;
  var fine = matchMedia('(hover:hover) and (pointer:fine)').matches;
  var bg=document.getElementById('bg'), loader=document.getElementById('loader');

  // FRAME-SEQUENCE SCROLL SCRUB (Apple-style): preload WebP frames, draw the scroll-mapped frame to a
  // canvas. No video decode, no range-request fragility — buttery, reliable, and mobile-safe.
  var cv=document.getElementById('reel'), ctx=cv.getContext('2d',{alpha:false});
  cv.width=1600; cv.height=900;   // upscaled source; CSS object-fit:cover scales it (cheap 1:1 blit, composite-light)
  var N=432, frames=new Array(N), loaded=0, lastIdx=-1, curIdx=0;
  function pad(n){ return ('00'+n).slice(-3); }
  function draw(idx){ var img=frames[idx]; if(!img||!img.complete||!img.naturalWidth) return; ctx.drawImage(img,0,0,1600,900); lastIdx=idx; }
  frames[0]=new Image(); frames[0].onload=function(){ draw(0); bg.classList.add('playing'); }; frames[0].src='https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/VanhDc/aura-assets@wallow-v1/wallow/frames/f_001.webp';
  if(!reduce){
    for(var i=1;i<N;i++){ (function(i){ var im=new Image();
      im.onload=function(){ loaded++; if(loaded>=N-1 && loader) loader.classList.add('hide'); };
      im.src='https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/VanhDc/aura-assets@wallow-v1/wallow/frames/f_'+pad(i+1)+'.webp'; frames[i]=im; })(i); }
    var vt=0, vc=0;
    (function scrub(){
      var max=document.documentElement.scrollHeight-window.innerHeight;
      vt = max>0 ? Math.min(1, Math.max(0, window.scrollY/max)) : 0;
      vc += (vt-vc)*0.14;
      if(Math.abs(vt-vc) < 0.0006) vc = vt;   // snap at rest: stops redrawing (idle -> 60fps)
      curIdx = Math.round(vc*(N-1));
      if(curIdx!==lastIdx) draw(curIdx);
      requestAnimationFrame(scrub);
    })();
  } else { if(loader) loader.classList.add('hide'); }

  // ---- split text: wrap words in overflow masks, chars in units ----
  function splitEl(el){
    var out=[], nodes=Array.prototype.slice.call(el.childNodes);
    el.textContent='';
    nodes.forEach(function(nd){
      var tint = nd.nodeType===1 ? nd.className : '';
      var text = nd.textContent;
      text.split(/(\s+)/).forEach(function(tok){
        if(!tok) return;
        if(/^\s+$/.test(tok)){ el.appendChild(document.createTextNode(' ')); return; }
        var w=document.createElement('span'); w.className='w';
        for(var i=0;i<tok.length;i++){
          var ch=document.createElement('span'); ch.className='c'+(tint?' '+tint:'');
          ch.textContent=tok[i]; w.appendChild(ch); out.push(ch);
        }
        el.appendChild(w);
      });
    });
    return out;
  }

  // placeholder links (press rows, socials, shop) must not jump the page to the top
  document.addEventListener('click',function(e){
    var a=e.target.closest && e.target.closest('a[href="#"]');
    if(a) e.preventDefault();
  });

  if(reduce){ return; }   // static page for reduced motion (CSS shows everything)

  gsap.registerPlugin(ScrollTrigger);
  var lenis=new Lenis({lerp:.1,smoothWheel:true});
  function raf(t){ lenis.raf(t); requestAnimationFrame(raf); } requestAnimationFrame(raf);
  lenis.on('scroll', ScrollTrigger.update);

  // split all display headlines
  document.querySelectorAll('[data-split]').forEach(function(el){
    var chars=splitEl(el);
    gsap.set(chars,{yPercent:112,rotate:5});
    gsap.to(chars,{yPercent:0,rotate:0,duration:1.05,stagger:.022,ease:'power4.out',
      scrollTrigger:{trigger:el.closest('.spread'),start:'top 72%'}});
  });

  // section reveals: rises + wipes + index rules
  document.querySelectorAll('.spread').forEach(function(sec){
    var tl=gsap.timeline({scrollTrigger:{trigger:sec, start:'top 72%'}});
    var wipes=sec.querySelectorAll('[data-wipe]'), rises=sec.querySelectorAll('[data-rise]'), rules=sec.querySelectorAll('.rule');
    if(wipes.length) tl.to(wipes,{clipPath:'inset(0 0 0% 0)',duration:1.0,stagger:.1,ease:'power4.out'},0);
    if(rises.length) tl.to(rises,{opacity:1,y:0,duration:.85,stagger:.07,ease:'power3.out'},.12);
    if(rules.length) tl.to(rules,{scaleX:1,duration:.8,ease:'power3.inOut'},.3);
  });

  // nav entrance
  gsap.from('#nav > *',{y:-18,opacity:0,duration:.9,stagger:.08,ease:'power3.out',delay:.15});

  // hero badge: rotation driven by scroll (no idle animation cost)
  gsap.to('#badgeSpin',{rotation:360,transformOrigin:'59px 59px',ease:'none',
    scrollTrigger:{trigger:'#wrap',start:'top top',end:'max',scrub:.6}});

  // scroll-velocity skew on the whole content plane (settles to 0 at rest)
  var skewTo=gsap.quickTo('#wrap','skewY',{duration:.5,ease:'power3.out'});
  lenis.on('scroll',function(e){ skewTo(gsap.utils.clamp(-2.2,2.2,(e.velocity||0)*.12)); });

  // manifesto: the section holds (CSS sticky) while the quote ignites word-by-word under the scroll.
  // Sticky, not ScrollTrigger pin: pin uses position:fixed, which breaks inside the always-transformed #wrap.
  (function(){
    var el=document.getElementById('mani'); if(!el) return;
    var nodes=Array.prototype.slice.call(el.childNodes), words=[];
    el.textContent='';
    nodes.forEach(function(nd){
      var tint=nd.nodeType===1?nd.className:'';
      nd.textContent.split(/(\s+)/).forEach(function(tok){
        if(!tok) return;
        if(/^\s+$/.test(tok)){ el.appendChild(document.createTextNode(' ')); return; }
        var w=document.createElement('span'); w.className='wd'+(tint?' '+tint:''); w.textContent=tok;
        el.appendChild(w); words.push(w);
      });
    });
    gsap.set(words,{y:'0.35em'});
    var tl=gsap.timeline({scrollTrigger:{trigger:'.s4',start:'top top',end:'bottom bottom',scrub:true}});
    tl.to(words,{opacity:1,y:0,duration:.25,stagger:.12,ease:'none'})
      .to('.s4 .att',{opacity:1,y:0,duration:.5,ease:'none'},'-=.15');
  })();

  // count-up stats
  document.querySelectorAll('[data-count]').forEach(function(el){
    var end=parseInt(el.getAttribute('data-count'),10), obj={v:0};
    gsap.to(obj,{v:end,duration:1.6,ease:'power2.out',
      onUpdate:function(){ el.textContent=Math.round(obj.v); },
      scrollTrigger:{trigger:el.closest('.spread'),start:'top 62%'}});
  });

  // range marquee: runs only while the section is on screen
  ScrollTrigger.create({trigger:'.s3',start:'top bottom',end:'bottom top',
    onToggle:function(st){ document.getElementById('tickwrap').classList.toggle('on',st.isActive); }});

  // range entrances: marquee band floats up, cards deal in one by one
  // (container tween only for the marquee; the .tick children belong to the CSS keyframe animation)
  gsap.from('#tickwrap',{y:54,opacity:0,duration:1.1,ease:'power3.out',
    scrollTrigger:{trigger:'.s3',start:'top 70%'}});
  gsap.from('.s3 .card',{y:110,opacity:0,rotate:2.5,duration:1.15,stagger:.15,ease:'power4.out',
    scrollTrigger:{trigger:'.s3',start:'top 58%'}});

  // card tilt + glare (desktop pointers only; transforms only, no idle cost)
  if(fine) document.querySelectorAll('[data-tilt]').forEach(function(card){
    var glare=card.querySelector('.glare');
    var rx=gsap.quickTo(card,'rotationX',{duration:.5,ease:'power3.out'});
    var ry=gsap.quickTo(card,'rotationY',{duration:.5,ease:'power3.out'});
    card.addEventListener('pointermove',function(ev){
      var r=card.getBoundingClientRect();
      var px=(ev.clientX-r.left)/r.width-.5, py=(ev.clientY-r.top)/r.height-.5;
      rx(-py*8); ry(px*10);
      if(glare) gsap.to(glare,{x:px*140+'%',duration:.5,ease:'power2.out'});
    });
    card.addEventListener('pointerleave',function(){ rx(0); ry(0);
      if(glare) gsap.to(glare,{x:'-70%',duration:.6,ease:'power2.out'}); });
  });

  // CTA letters: playful jump on hover
  if(fine) document.querySelectorAll('#cta .c').forEach(function(ch){
    ch.addEventListener('pointerenter',function(){
      gsap.to(ch,{yPercent:-16,duration:.18,ease:'power2.out',overwrite:true,
        onComplete:function(){ gsap.to(ch,{yPercent:0,duration:.6,ease:'elastic.out(1,.45)'}); }});
    });
  });

  // dye bloom trails the pointer (native cursor stays; colour follows the section under the viewport)
  if(fine){
    var dye=document.getElementById('dye');
    var dx=gsap.quickTo(dye,'x',{duration:.9,ease:'power2.out'}), dy=gsap.quickTo(dye,'y',{duration:.9,ease:'power2.out'});
    window.addEventListener('pointermove',function(e){
      document.body.classList.add('hascur');
      dx(e.clientX); dy(e.clientY);
    },{passive:true});
    document.querySelectorAll('[data-dye]').forEach(function(sec){
      ScrollTrigger.create({trigger:sec,start:'top 55%',end:'bottom 55%',
        onToggle:function(st){ if(st.isActive) document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--dyec',sec.getAttribute('data-dye')); }});
    });
  }

  window.addEventListener('load', function(){ setTimeout(function(){ ScrollTrigger.refresh(); }, 300); });
})();
</script>
